# RigPose

Kind: component · Defined in [`src/logic/agents/rig_pose.h`](../../../src/logic/agents/rig_pose.h) · Described in `data/agents_motion.json`

A rig's pose as joint angles: the pelvis' world pose and one constraint-frame rotation per joint (identity at rest).

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `root_position` | `glm::vec3` | world position of the pelvis segment (default glm::vec3(0.0)) |
| `root_rotation` | `glm::quat` | world rotation of the pelvis segment (default glm::quat(1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0)) |
| `joint` | `std::vector<glm::quat>` | per joint, rotation in its constraint frame (X twist, Y plane, Z normal) |
| `teleport` | `bool` | the next RigPoseApply sets the bodies instead of moving them (default true) |

## Notes

On the rig entity (the one with HumanBotSpawn), created at the spawn pose by ensureRig. GaitBase writes it, GaitBalance places the pelvis, Fabrik corrects the chains, RigPoseApply moves the kinematic bodies to it.

## Systems that touch it

Read only by: GaitFootIK, GaitHandIK. Written by: Fabrik, GaitBalance, GaitBase, GaitChecks, GaitRoutes, RigPoseApply. Created by: Fabrik, GaitBalance, GaitBase, GaitChecks, GaitFootIK, GaitHandIK, GaitRoutes. Destroyed by: —.

| System | Kind | Scope | Access | Where | What it does with it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Fabrik](../systems/Fabrik.md) | system | World | **readwrite+create** | tick, ensureRig | the chains' joints solved in place; created at the spawn pose by ensureRig |
| [GaitBalance](../systems/GaitBalance.md) | system | World | **readwrite+create** | tick, ensureRig | root position and the leaned spine joints written |
| [GaitBase](../systems/GaitBase.md) | system | World | **readwrite+create** | tick, ensureRig | pelvis, spine, head and arm joints written; teleport set on the first tick |
| [GaitChecks](../systems/GaitChecks.md) | system | World | **write+create** | tick, ensureRig | only created by ensureRig; not read |
| [GaitFootIK](../systems/GaitFootIK.md) | system | World | **read+create** | tick, ensureRig | copied for trial solves |
| [GaitHandIK](../systems/GaitHandIK.md) | system | World | **read+create** | tick, ensureRig | copied for the trial pose |
| [GaitRoutes](../systems/GaitRoutes.md) | system | World | **write+create** | ensureRig | the spawn pose, on the first call |
| [RigPoseApply](../systems/RigPoseApply.md) | system | World | **readwrite** | tick | the pose applied; teleport cleared |

## Side effects of those systems

- **[Fabrik](../systems/Fabrik.md)**: none beyond its components.
- **[GaitBalance](../systems/GaitBalance.md)**: none beyond its components.
- **[GaitBase](../systems/GaitBase.md)**: none beyond its components.
- **[GaitChecks](../systems/GaitChecks.md)**: none beyond its components.
- **[GaitFootIK](../systems/GaitFootIK.md)**
  - Creates two IK chain entities and two IK target entities on the first tick of a gait.
- **[GaitHandIK](../systems/GaitHandIK.md)**
  - Creates two IK chain entities and two IK target entities the first time scrambling is on.
- **[GaitRoutes](../systems/GaitRoutes.md)**
  - Destroys the old legs' IK chain and target entities at each new route (the arms' ones, if any, are left behind).
  - Logs a warning when no route in the slope band is found.
- **[RigPoseApply](../systems/RigPoseApply.md)**
  - Moves or teleports every kinematic Jolt body of the bot each tick.
  - Logs an error once per process when the bot is not kinematic.
